Package frc.robot

Interface Constants.SimDefaults

Enclosing interface:
Constants
public static interface Constants.SimDefaults
Gains the library's shipped simulations start from.

These exist purely so SimArmSubsystem and SimElevatorSubsystem produce sensible motion with no setup — a team bringing up robot code before the mechanism is built should see it move. They are not tuning advice: they are sized to hold a typical mechanism against gravity and are applied to the simulation's own plant, which has no friction, no compliance, and no motor dynamics. Real gains must be tuned on the real mechanism.

They live here rather than in the IO classes so the two simulations stay consistent and so a team can see at a glance what the library assumes.

    • ARM_KD

      static final double ARM_KD
      Derivative gain for SimArmSubsystem, in volts per rotation per second.

      Non-zero because a position loop on a heavy arm is a second-order system: without damping it oscillates around the target instead of settling.

      See Also:
      • Constant Field Values

    • ARM_KS

      static final double ARM_KS
      Static gain for SimArmSubsystem's feedforward, in volts.

      The voltage needed to overcome the mechanism's own friction at rest. WPILib's example uses a small positive figure for this; the simulation has no friction, so zero is honest.
